title: CIPHER
note: PUBLIC CODES, NOT SECURITY. ANYONE WITH THIS PAGE CAN READ THEM. THE KEYWORD CIPHER SLOWS A GLANCE, NOT A CODEBREAKER.

items.title: MORSE
items.use: LETTERS, NUMBERS, SIGNALS · LIGHT, SOUND OR TAPS
prosigns: DISTRESS · SENT AS ONE RUN, NO GAPS
timing: GAP INSIDE A LETTER = 1 · BETWEEN LETTERS = 3 · BETWEEN WORDS = 7
BY LIGHT: COUNT IN YOUR HEAD, KEEP THE DASH CLEARLY LONGER THAN THE DOT. SLOW AND EVEN BEATS FAST.

items.title: PHONETIC
items.use: ALFA TO ZULU · SPELLING OVER A RADIO OR PHONE
timing: SAY NUMBERS DIGIT BY DIGIT: 1250 = WUN TOO FIFE ZERO.
PLATES AND ADDRESSES: SPELL EVERY LETTER, EVEN THE OBVIOUS ONES.
ROGER = RECEIVED · WILCO = WILL COMPLY · SAY AGAIN = REPEAT (NEVER 'REPEAT').

items.title: TAP CODE
items.use: KNOCKING THROUGH A WALL OR PIPE · 5×5 GRID
timing: TAP THE ROW, PAUSE, TAP THE COLUMN.
C AND K SHARE A SQUARE · USE C FOR K.
X = PAUSE BETWEEN SENTENCES · A FAST RUN OF TAPS = DIDN'T GET IT, SEND AGAIN.

items.title: HAND SIGNALS
rows: ARM UP, SWEEP THE HAND DOWN AND TOWARD YOU
PALM DOWN, PUSH TOWARD THE GROUND
TWO FINGERS TO YOUR EYES, THEN POINT
FLAT HAND ACROSS THE THROAT, POINT TO IT
ARM UP, CIRCLE THE HAND OVER YOUR HEAD
ARM OUT, PALM DOWN, PUSH UP AND DOWN
FIST PUMPED UP AND DOWN AT THE SHOULDER
HAND ON TOP OF THE HEAD · ANSWER THE SAME
HAND CUPPED BEHIND THE EAR, OR PALMS UP
timing: CONFIRM SIGNALS WITH YOUR PARTNER BEFORE YOU NEED THEM. THESE VARY BY GROUP.
